name: Temporary Admin Login
description: Generate temporary token-based login links for admin access.
project_description:
You can generate secure, self-expiring ⏱️, automatic login links 🔗 for Drupal to provide admin access to your site for developers or for editors to quickly review work. Recipients can log in simply by clicking the link, without needing a password.

 How to install: 

 
 Download and extract files in the module folder. 
 Enable module from the module list. 
 Go to admin menu >> configuration >> system >> 
 Generate Temporary Admin Login Link. 
 Select role and set time as per your need and click on generate link and you will get link.
